text:
{item:magic_staff}杖头两侧是{b}装载槽{/b}：魔晶石放上去，就把它带的供给交给法杖；一颗晶石只给一把法杖。没装晶石的法杖只是一根木棍。装了一颗，每过一轮冷却打一发；装了几颗，就按顺时针一颗一颗轮着打，颗与颗之间隔一个单次冷却，一轮打完歇一个总冷却。悬浮窗上写着装了几颗、怎么轮。

魔晶石有耐久：一场仗里给法杖供过能，打完就少一次，名字跟着从{b}明亮的{/b}变成{b}闪烁的{/b}、{b}黯淡的{/b}；用完碎成{item:crystal_shards}，不再供能，装载槽也空出来。放在{item:rune_pouch}里的魔晶石不耗耐久。

texts.en:
The two sides of the {item:magic_staff}'s head are {b}loading slots{/b}: place a Crystal there and it hands its supply to the staff. One Crystal feeds only one staff. A staff with no Crystal is just a stick. With one Crystal loaded, the staff fires once per Cooldown; with several, it fires them one at a time in clockwise order, waiting one single Cooldown between Crystals and resting one total Cooldown after each full round. The tooltip shows how many are loaded and in what order they fire.

Crystals have Durability: each battle in which a Crystal powers a staff costs it one use when the battle ends, and its name changes from {b}Bright{/b} to {b}Flickering{/b} to {b}Dim{/b}. Once used up, it shatters into {item:crystal_shards}, stops supplying power, and frees its loading slot. Crystals kept in a {item:rune_pouch} lose no Durability.
